exposure: geographical trajectory/distance traveled in the antepartum period
cohort: The study included 4,643 premature infants in Pernambuco, Brazil, who experienced neonatal death between 2013 and 2019.
finding: The median survival for preterm infants who died neonatally was two days, with survival time decreasing by 16% for mixed-race mothers, and longer antepartum travel distances (0-163.5km) to birth facilities were associated with a significant proportion (92.2%) of neonatal deaths and shorter neonatal survival times.
followup_time: up to 28 days post-birth (neonatal period), or until neonatal death if sooner
